findings.claim: Hilton 10-K FY2025 risk factor: if Hilton fails to keep pace with AI developments, competitors or third parties may incorporate AI faster and impair its competitive position.
findings.excerpt: If we fail to keep pace with rapidly evolving technological developments in AI, our competitive position and business results may suffer. Our competitors or other third parties may incorporate AI into their operations more quickly or successfully than us, or develop superior offerings with the aid of AI, which could impair our ability to compete effectively and adversely affect our results of operations.

findings.claim: Skift: Hilton and Marriott filings flag AI platforms as risk to direct bookings, possibly steering guests to OTAs and raising distribution costs.
findings.source: Skift: New Marriott and Hilton Filings Reveal Risks From AI Platforms to Direct Bookings
findings.excerpt: artificial intelligence, chatgpt, direct bookings, direct channel, distribution, earnings, future of lodging, google, hilton, marriott Key Points Hilton and Marriott both flagged AI platforms such as ChatGPT as new risks to their direct booking channels in recent SEC filings. Both hotel giants warned that AI could redirect bookings to online travel agencies (OTAs), increasing distribution
